synthesizedFacts.fact: Niacinamide is a form of vitamin B3 known for its benefits in skincare, such as anti-inflammatory and brightening effects.
There is no strong scientific evidence supporting the effectiveness of niacinamide in whitening teeth.
Niacinamide toothpaste may be safe for oral health but should not replace proven whitening or anti-cavity products.
Social media has played a significant role in popularizing niacinamide toothpaste despite the lack of scientific backing.
